newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends easier.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends easier.

text.p: London white sugar futures ended easier on Tuesday after selling of the nearby months followed a downturn in sentiment on the raws market.
Spot March dropped below support at $310.00 and hit an intraday low of $308.00 before last trading at $308.40 which was down $$3.30. May was off $3.10 at $307.40.
Traders cited commission house and some trade selling.
Total volume was 2408 lots. Local traders said the sell-off on the raws was largely a response to Commitment of Traders data released on Monday.
Fundamental news was thin although Sri Lanka and Syria both tender on Wednesday to buy one cargo of white sugar for February shipment dates.
